title: The refusals-reach-the-owner guard fires once per refusal, and stays quiet once the session has raised it
why: Coordinator 12:56 CST Nov 8, sighting, possible false alarm: the guard re-fired on every reply in lane habit-is-not-a-guard after the lane had already raised the auto-mode force-push refusal (#2183, about 12:50 CST). A guard that fires when nothing is wrong teaches the reader to scroll past it. Fix: the guard marks a refusal raised once a reply names it, and does not fire again for that refusal.
note: Sighting (lane agent-report-shas-resolve, 13:35 CST Nov 8): one auto-mode refusal re-blocked 8 turns after the reply had raised it. The lane proposes a key on the refused command, once per session. Folded here instead of a new step refusal-guard-once.
